trends.title: AI Labs Transition Toward Autonomous Computer Agents
trends.what_happened: OpenAI, Google, and independent developers are releasing tools that let AI interact directly with operating systems and code.
trends.why_it_matters: This shifts AI from a question-answering tool to a software collaborator that can perform multi-step digital work.
